projects.title: LiteWarden
projects.desc:
A Chrome extension hosted on Github to manage users' passwords seamlessly and
                            locally on their browser — nothing goes to datacenters outside their computer. Free of cost. —
                            January 2026

projects.alt: Video thumbnail: Purv holding his 3D-printed air quality monitor in his workshop
projects.title: Air Quality Monitor
projects.desc:
A pocket-sized air quality monitor I built when Delhi's smog hit record highs: an
                            MQ135 gas sensor feeds an Arduino Nano, and a 128×64 OLED shows the live reading with a verdict
                            like “Hazardous”, all in a 3D-printed case. Watch it on YouTube. — November 2025

projects.alt: Video thumbnail: Purv demonstrating his Arduino radar, with the sweep plotted on a monitor behind him
projects.title: Radar System
projects.desc:
An ultrasonic sensor on a 180° servo sweeps the room while an Arduino UNO
                            measures distances, and a radar screen I coded in Processing plots every object it detects in
                            real time. — May 2026

projects.alt: Screenshot of the Velvet Pour landing page: the word MOJITO in large serif letters over a cocktail glass between monstera leaves
projects.title: Velvet Pour
projects.desc:
A GSAP-animated cocktail brand landing page — scroll-triggered timelines and
                            SplitText reveals built with React and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel. — August 2026

projects.title: Neo-Pixel Game
projects.desc: A 30-second arcade game on an 8×8 NeoPixel grid: slide a 3-LED paddle to catch falling apples as the speed ramps up, on an Arduino Uno in a 3D-printed case. — Jan 2026
